mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event ( id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, published_time FROM outbox_event WHERE ( status = 0 AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ) OR ( status = 1 AND next_retry_time <= NOW() ) ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 2, next_retry_time = NULL, published_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 3, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
